raw.query: WITH ex AS (SELECT model, signal, (detail->'1s'->>'cov90')::float AS c1, (detail->'15s'->>'cov90')::float AS c15, (detail->'1min'->>'cov90')::float AS c60 FROM quantile_coverage) SELECT MIN(LEAST(c1,c15,c60)) AS cov90_min, MAX(GREATEST(c1,c15,c60)) AS cov90_max, AVG((c1+c15+c60)/3) AS cov90_avg, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ex
